To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we observed a 15 times enhancement for Ho3+ green UC emission in Ho3+ Y3+ co-doped LiNbO3 crystal under 800 nm fs laser excitation.
the Ho3+ Yd3+ Nd3+ triply doped LiNbO3 crystal shows 15 times enhancement in Ho3+ green UC emission intensity compared to the singly doped LiNb O3 crystal.
the green UC emission in Ho3+ Yd3+ co doped LiNbO3 is 15 times stronger than in Ho3+ single doped LiNb3.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the investigation of energy transfer between Nd3+ and Yb3+ in triply doped LiNbO3 crystals.
the development of new laser materials based on triply doped crystals with high energy transfer efficiency and the enhancement of UC emission in the Ho3+ doped crystals.
the enhancement of upconversion emission in triply doped LiNbO3 crystals under 800 nm laser irradiation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Yb3+ is a very effective sensitizer to enhance the Ho3+ UC emissions.
Yb3+ is an efficient sensitizer for Nd3+ and Ho3+ UC emission in LiNb03 crystal.
the green UC emission is dominated by multi ion interactions whereas the red UC emission is mainly dominated by the Ho3+ excited state absorption.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the energy transfer from Nd3+ to Ho3+ is enhanced by the Yb3+ ions.

the energy transfer efficiency can be increased by increasing the concentration of the sensitizer and by increasing the concentration difference of the sensitizer (Yb3+ and Ho3+) in the triply doped LiNbO3.
the Ho3+ Yd3+ and Nd 3+ triply doped LiNbO3 crystals have potential applications in the field of optical storage and upconversion luminescence.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the energy transfer efficiency of the Yb3+ can be enhanced by the Nd3+, which can be applied to other upconversion systems.
the energy transfer between Yb3+ ions and Nd3+ ions is much more efficient than that between Yb3 + and Ho3+.
Yb3+ is an efficient bridging ion to increase the energy transfer efficiency and enhance the UC emission in triply doped Ho3+(Yb3+ Nd3+) system in LiNbO.
